notes.title: 15.09.2022 Steam Update
Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunt released on Steam!
Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunt Playtest is live right now
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41995622/ed37c837599fd8ff31d613921b48b90a7bc2d5b9.jpg[/img]
[b]Hello Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunt fans![/b]

We have some great news for you. As we've promised in our previous January news update, we've finished our Steam Beta release and are ready to show you how the game looks and most importantly plays on the PC.

Right now, anyone who owns [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/293520/Carnivores_Dinosaur_Hunter_Reborn/]Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunter Reborn[/url] can access Playtest by downloading [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1806660]Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunt Playtest[/url] from their Steam Library.

We're planning to hold Playtest for at least a month and make a decision on a release date based on the community feedback. During this testing period, we'd like to make sure that we've ironed out all bugs and that all PC specific features are working as intended. During the same period, we’ll be preparing for the release of the update for all platforms as well as the first DLC release that will introduce two more carnivore dinosaurs into the game.

Speaking of the update, Playtest will have some improvements to the game that is yet to be released on consoles, such as:
[list]
[*] Multiple gameplay, sound, and UI bug-fixes;
[*] Improved UI/UX experience based on community feedback;
[*] The ability to choose which dinosaurs to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1461030/discussions/1/3186863876571477618/]spawn and the density of their spawns[/url].
[/list]

Using this opportunity we’d like to remind you that the game has an official [url=https://www.facebook.com/CarnivoresDinosaurHunt]Facebook[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1461030/Carnivores_Dinosaur_Hunt/]Steam page[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1461030]Community page[/url]  and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1806660]Playtest Community page[/url].

So if you own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/293520/Carnivores_Dinosaur_Hunter_Reborn/]Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunter Reborn[/url] please feel free to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1806660]join the Playtest[/url] and make sure to share your feedback on its community page. It’s your feedback that helps us make the game better.

Lastly, we’re going to give [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1461030/Carnivores_Dinosaur_Hunt/]Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunt[/url] (on its release) for FREE to EVERYONE who has previously purchased [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/293520/Carnivores_Dinosaur_Hunter_Reborn/]Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunter Reborn[/url] on Steam.

Thank you all for your support and patience. We appreciate it!
 

[b]Stay safe and good hunting,
DDE Team[/b]
